summary.text: Greg Kmetz is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 36 who is running for Montana State Senate District 18 on November 3, 2026, and is not seeking re-election to the House.
A welding and machine shop owner and former welding instructor from Miles City, he has served in the House since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Greg Kmetz was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, lives in Miles City, Montana, and earned a bachelor's degree in industrial education from the University of Wyoming.
His career experience includes owning his own welding and machine shop and working as a welding instructor.

Kmetz has served in the Montana House since 2023, and in the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations Committee and a member of the House Legislative Administration, House Judiciary and Agriculture committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 18 and faces Democrat Stan Taylor in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.
